name: Monotonic Yang Dimension / Log Shattering (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, monotonic Yang dimension is $n-1$, while log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, log shattering is $\log_2(n+1)$, while monotonic Yang dimension is $1$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Monotonic Yang Dimension and Log Shattering of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
